lines.en_raw: Huh, no way, it was suicide?
I heard it was an accident.
No, they say he stuck
his own head in.
...Into the incinerator?
I heard he died screaming horribly.
...He saw it too, didn't he?
Yeah, in the woods out back.
...A friend told me
a former swim team member did too.
Said he saw it a while back.
You mean the one who drowned?
The story is it wasn't the pool.
He died in the bath at his own house.
...Then, is this one a curse too?
The boy who had all his organs
pulled out by some pervert.
I heard! The Karugane Elementary one.
They say it was exactly the 100th day.
After seeing that thing,
he died on the 100th day?
All the other stories too? Day 100?
I don't know.
Want to check the dates and count?
...I'll pass.
But is that thing really out there?
...A crow with a human face.
...Want to go check? The woods out back.
...No way. I mean, nobody
ever goes into those woods.
The place has a nasty feel to it.
Anyone who'd go there is the weird one.
They die because they're weird. For sure.
There's no such thing as a curse...
